ticker_news.title: Massive News for Meta Platforms Stock Investors
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms is planning to borrow $30 billion, a significant capital structure decision that could impact investors' strategies and the company's financial positioning.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa

ticker_news.title: Snap Stock Soars on $400M Perplexity Deal, Marking Bold AI Integration Shift
ticker_news.description: Snap Inc. announced a $400 million partnership with AI startup Perplexity, integrating an AI-powered answer engine into Snapchat's chat interface. The deal caused Snap's stock to surge 18% in premarket trading, signaling a strategic move to enhance AI capabilities and compete with larger tech rivals.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Fries
